132:         attrs: quick_xml::events::attributes::Attributes,
133:     ) -> Result<(Option<i64>, Option<i64>), QueryError> {
134:         let mut s: Option<i64> = None;
135:         let mut e: Option<i64> = None;
136:         for attr_result in attrs {
137:             let Ok(attr) = attr_result else {
138:                 return Err(QueryError::MalformedXml);
139:             };
140:             let key = name_to_str(attr.key.as_ref());
141:             let k = local_name(key);
142:             let val = attr
143:                 .unescape_value()
144:                 .map(|v| v.into_owned())
145:                 .unwrap_or_default();
146:             if k == "start" {
147:                 s = Some(parse_ical_datetime(&val)?);
148:             } else if k == "end" {
149:                 e = Some(parse_ical_datetime(&val)?);
150:             }
151:         }
152:         Ok((s, e))
153:     }
154: 
155:     loop {
156:         match reader.read_event_into(&mut buf) {
157:             Ok(Event::Start(ref start)) => {
158:                 let local_name_ref = start.local_name();
159:                 let local = name_to_str(local_name_ref.as_ref());
160:                 if !root_seen {
161:                     if local != "calendar-query" {
162:                         return Err(QueryError::UnsupportedRoot);
163:                     }
164:                     root_seen = true;
165:                     depth = 1;
166:                     continue;
167:                 }
168:                 depth += 1;
169:                 if in_filter {
170:                     filter_depth += 1;
171:                     if local == "time-range" {
172:                         found_time_range = true;
173:                         let (s, e) = extract_time_range(start.attributes())?;
174:                         start_utc = start_utc.or(s);
175:                         end_utc = end_utc.or(e);
176:                     } else if local != "filter" {
177:                         unsupported_in_filter = true;
178:                     }
179:                 } else if local == "filter" {
180:                     in_filter = true;
181:                     filter_depth = 1;
182:                 }
183:             }
184:             Ok(Event::Empty(ref empty)) => {
185:                 let local_name_ref = empty.local_name();
186:                 let local = name_to_str(local_name_ref.as_ref());
187:                 if !root_seen {
188:                     if local != "calendar-query" {
189:                         return Err(QueryError::UnsupportedRoot);
190:                     }
191:                     root_seen = true;
192:                     continue;
193:                 }
194:                 if in_filter {
195:                     if local == "time-range" {
196:                         found_time_range = true;
197:                         let (s, e) = extract_time_range(empty.attributes())?;
198:                         start_utc = start_utc.or(s);
199:                         end_utc = end_utc.or(e);
200:                     } else if local != "filter" {
201:                         unsupported_in_filter = true;
202:                     }
203:                 }
204:             }
205:             Ok(Event::End(_)) => {
206:                 depth = depth.saturating_sub(1);
207:                 if in_filter {
208:                     filter_depth = filter_depth.saturating_sub(1);
209:                     if filter_depth == 0 {
210:                         in_filter = false;
211:                     }
212:                 }
213:             }
214:             Ok(Event::Eof) => {
215:                 if depth > 0 {
216:                     return Err(QueryError::MalformedXml);
217:                 }
218:                 break;
219:             }
220:             Ok(_) => {}
221:             Err(_) => return Err(QueryError::MalformedXml),
222:         }
223:         buf.clear();
224:     }
225: 
226:     if !root_seen {
227:         return Err(QueryError::UnsupportedRoot);
228:     }
229:     if unsupported_in_filter {
230:         return Err(QueryError::UnsupportedFilter);
231:     }
232:     if !found_time_range {
233:         return Err(QueryError::MissingFilter);
234:     }
235:     let start = start_utc.ok_or(QueryError::InvalidDateTime)?;
236:     let end = end_utc.ok_or(QueryError::InvalidDateTime)?;
237:     if start >= end {
238:         return Err(QueryError::InvalidRange);
239:     }
240:     if end - start > MAX_RANGE_SECONDS {
241:         return Err(QueryError::RangeTooLarge);
242:     }
243:     Ok(CalendarQuery {
244:         start_utc: start,
245:         end_utc: end,
246:     })
247: }

249: /// Parse a `calendar-multiget` REPORT body into its requested hrefs.
250: ///
251: /// Only `<D:href>` elements that are direct children of the root are
252: /// captured. The list is bounded by `MAX_MULTIGET_HREFS`.
253: pub fn parse_calendar_multiget(body: &[u8]) -> Result<CalendarMultiget, QueryError> {
254:     if body.len() > MAX_BODY_BYTES {
255:         return Err(QueryError::MalformedXml);
256:     }
257:     let text = std::str::from_utf8(body).map_err(|_| QueryError::MalformedXml)?;
258:     let mut reader = Reader::from_str(text);
259:     reader.config_mut().trim_text(true);
260: 
261:     let mut buf = Vec::new();
262:     let mut root_seen = false;
263:     let mut depth: u32 = 0;
264:     let mut hrefs: Vec<String> = Vec::new();
265:     let mut capturing_href = false;
266:     let mut current_href = String::new();
267: 
268:     loop {
269:         match reader.read_event_into(&mut buf) {
270:             Ok(Event::Start(ref start)) => {
271:                 let local_name_ref = start.local_name();
272:                 let local = name_to_str(local_name_ref.as_ref());
273:                 if !root_seen {
274:                     if local != "calendar-multiget" {
275:                         return Err(QueryError::UnsupportedRoot);
276:                     }
277:                     root_seen = true;
278:                     depth = 1;
279:                     continue;
280:                 }
281:                 depth += 1;
282:                 if depth == 2 && local == "href" {
283:                     capturing_href = true;
284:                     current_href.clear();
285:                 }
286:             }
287:             Ok(Event::Empty(ref empty)) => {
288:                 let local_name_ref = empty.local_name();
289:                 let local = name_to_str(local_name_ref.as_ref());
290:                 if !root_seen {
291:                     if local != "calendar-multiget" {
292:                         return Err(QueryError::UnsupportedRoot);
293:                     }
294:                     root_seen = true;
295:                     continue;
296:                 }
297:                 depth += 1;
298:                 if depth == 2 && local == "href" {
299:                     // Self-closing href carries no text; record it as empty.
300:                     if hrefs.len() >= MAX_MULTIGET_HREFS {
301:                         return Err(QueryError::TooManyHrefs);
302:                     }
303:                     hrefs.push(String::new());
304:                 }
305:                 depth = depth.saturating_sub(1);
306:             }
307:             Ok(Event::Text(ref text_event)) => {
308:                 if capturing_href {
309:                     current_href.push_str(text_event.unescape().unwrap_or_default().as_ref());
310:                 }
311:             }
312:             Ok(Event::End(_)) => {
313:                 if capturing_href {
314:                     capturing_href = false;
315:                     if hrefs.len() >= MAX_MULTIGET_HREFS {
316:                         return Err(QueryError::TooManyHrefs);
317:                     }
318:                     hrefs.push(current_href.trim().to_owned());
319:                 }
320:                 depth = depth.saturating_sub(1);
321:             }
322:             Ok(Event::Eof) => {
323:                 if depth > 0 {
324:                     return Err(QueryError::MalformedXml);
325:                 }
326:                 break;
327:             }
328:             Ok(_) => {}
329:             Err(_) => return Err(QueryError::MalformedXml),
330:         }
331:         buf.clear();
332:     }
333: 
334:     if !root_seen {
335:         return Err(QueryError::UnsupportedRoot);
336:     }
337:     if hrefs.is_empty() {
338:         return Err(QueryError::MissingHref);
339:     }
340:     Ok(CalendarMultiget { hrefs })
341: }

343: /// Parse a `sync-collection` REPORT body into its sync token and level.
344: ///
345: /// The `sync-token` element is optional: an absent or empty token requests an
346: /// initial snapshot. The `sync-level` element must be present and equal to 1
347: /// for calendar sync; any other value is rejected.
348: pub fn parse_sync_collection(body: &[u8]) -> Result<SyncCollection, QueryError> {
349:     if body.len() > MAX_BODY_BYTES {
350:         return Err(QueryError::MalformedXml);
351:     }
352:     let text = std::str::from_utf8(body).map_err(|_| QueryError::MalformedXml)?;
353:     let mut reader = Reader::from_str(text);
354:     reader.config_mut().trim_text(true);
355: 
356:     let mut buf = Vec::new();
357:     let mut root_seen = false;
358:     let mut depth: u32 = 0;
359:     let mut sync_token: Option<String> = None;
360:     let mut sync_level: Option<u32> = None;
361:     let mut capturing: Option<&'static str> = None;
362:     let mut current = String::new();
363: 
364:     loop {
365:         match reader.read_event_into(&mut buf) {
366:             Ok(Event::Start(ref start)) => {
367:                 let local_name_ref = start.local_name();
368:                 let local = name_to_str(local_name_ref.as_ref());
369:                 if !root_seen {
370:                     if local != "sync-collection" {
371:                         return Err(QueryError::UnsupportedRoot);
372:                     }
373:                     root_seen = true;
374:                     depth = 1;
375:                     continue;
376:                 }
377:                 depth += 1;
378:                 if depth == 2 {
379:                     if local == "sync-token" {
380:                         capturing = Some("token");
381:                         current.clear();
382:                     } else if local == "sync-level" {
383:                         capturing = Some("level");
384:                         current.clear();
385:                     }
386:                 }
387:             }
388:             Ok(Event::Empty(ref empty)) => {
389:                 let local_name_ref = empty.local_name();
390:                 let local = name_to_str(local_name_ref.as_ref());
391:                 if !root_seen {
392:                     if local != "sync-collection" {
393:                         return Err(QueryError::UnsupportedRoot);
394:                     }
395:                     root_seen = true;
396:                     continue;
397:                 }
398:                 depth += 1;
399:                 if depth == 2 && local == "sync-token" {
400:                     // Self-closing sync-token carries no text: initial snapshot.
401:                     sync_token = Some(String::new());
402:                 }
403:                 depth = depth.saturating_sub(1);
404:             }
405:             Ok(Event::Text(ref text_event)) => {
406:                 if capturing.is_some() {
407:                     current.push_str(text_event.unescape().unwrap_or_default().as_ref());
408:                 }
409:             }
410:             Ok(Event::End(_)) => {
411:                 if let Some(kind) = capturing {
412:                     capturing = None;
413:                     let value = current.trim().to_owned();
414:                     match kind {
415:                         "token" => {
416:                             sync_token = Some(value);
417:                         }
418:                         "level" => {
419:                             sync_level = value.parse::<u32>().ok();
420:                         }
421:                         _ => {}
422:                     }
423:                 }
424:                 depth = depth.saturating_sub(1);
425:             }
426:             Ok(Event::Eof) => {
427:                 if depth > 0 {
428:                     return Err(QueryError::MalformedXml);
429:                 }
430:                 break;
431:             }
432:             Ok(_) => {}
433:             Err(_) => return Err(QueryError::MalformedXml),
434:         }
435:         buf.clear();
436:     }
437: 
438:     if !root_seen {
439:         return Err(QueryError::UnsupportedRoot);
440:     }
441:     let level = sync_level.ok_or(QueryError::BadSyncLevel)?;
442:     if level != 1 {
443:         return Err(QueryError::BadSyncLevel);
444:     }
445:     let token = sync_token.unwrap_or_default();
446:     Ok(SyncCollection {
447:         sync_token: if token.is_empty() { None } else { Some(token) },
448:         sync_level: level,
449:     })
450: }

452: /// Determine the report type from the body and parse it accordingly.
453: pub fn parse_calendar_report(body: &[u8]) -> Result<CalendarReport, QueryError> {
454:     if body.len() > MAX_BODY_BYTES {
455:         return Err(QueryError::MalformedXml);
456:     }
457:     let text = std::str::from_utf8(body).map_err(|_| QueryError::MalformedXml)?;
458:     let root = peek_root(text).ok_or(QueryError::UnsupportedRoot)?;
459:     match root.as_str() {
460:         "calendar-query" => Ok(CalendarReport::Query(parse_calendar_query(body)?)),
461:         "calendar-multiget" => Ok(CalendarReport::Multiget(parse_calendar_multiget(body)?)),
462:         "sync-collection" => Ok(CalendarReport::SyncCollection(parse_sync_collection(body)?)),
463:         _ => Err(QueryError::UnsupportedRoot),
464:     }
465: }
466: 
467: /// Read the first element name in an XML document, if any.
468: fn peek_root(text: &str) -> Option<String> {
469:     let mut reader = Reader::from_str(text);
470:     reader.config_mut().trim_text(true);
471:     let mut buf = Vec::new();
472:     loop {
473:         match reader.read_event_into(&mut buf) {
474:             Ok(Event::Start(ref start)) => {
475:                 return Some(name_to_str(start.local_name().as_ref()).to_owned());
476:             }
477:             Ok(Event::Empty(ref empty)) => {
478:                 return Some(name_to_str(empty.local_name().as_ref()).to_owned());
479:             }
480:             Ok(Event::Eof) => return None,
481:             Ok(_) => {}
482:             Err(_) => return None,
483:         }
484:         buf.clear();
485:     }
486: }

-- Migration 0010: recurring_events
-- Adds recurrence_rule to events and creates event_recurrence_exceptions table.
-- Idempotent: uses CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS and CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS.

ALTER TABLE events ADD COLUMN recurrence_rule TEXT;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS event_recurrence_exceptions (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    series_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES events(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    recurrence_id INTEGER,
    recurrence_date TEXT,
    is_deleted INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (is_deleted IN (0, 1)),
    title TEXT,
    description TEXT,
    location TEXT,
    status TEXT CHECK (status IN ('tentative', 'confirmed', 'cancelled')),
    timed_start_utc INTEGER,
    timed_end_utc INTEGER,
    event_timezone TEXT,
    all_day_start_date TEXT,
    all_day_end_date TEXT,
    last_edited_by_user_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),
    created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
    updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
    CHECK (
        (recurrence_id IS NOT NULL AND recurrence_date IS NULL)
        OR
        (recurrence_id IS NULL
            AND recurrence_date IS NOT NULL
            AND length(recurrence_date) = 10)
    ),
    CHECK (
        (is_deleted = 1
            AND title IS NULL
            AND status IS NULL
            AND timed_start_utc IS NULL
            AND timed_end_utc IS NULL
            AND event_timezone IS NULL
            AND all_day_start_date IS NULL
            AND all_day_end_date IS NULL)
        OR
        (is_deleted = 0
            AND title IS NOT NULL
            AND length(trim(title)) > 0
            AND status IS NOT NULL
            AND (
                (timed_start_utc IS NOT NULL
                    AND timed_end_utc IS NOT NULL
                    AND timed_start_utc < timed_end_utc
                    AND event_timezone IS NOT NULL
                    AND length(trim(event_timezone)) > 0
                    AND all_day_start_date IS NULL
                    AND all_day_end_date IS NULL)
                OR
                (timed_start_utc IS NULL
                    AND timed_end_utc IS NULL
                    AND event_timezone IS NULL
                    AND all_day_start_date IS NOT NULL
                    AND all_day_end_date IS NOT NULL
                    AND all_day_start_date < all_day_end_date)
            ))
    )
);

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS event_recurrence_exceptions_timed_idx
ON event_recurrence_exceptions(series_id, recurrence_id);

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS event_recurrence_exceptions_all_day_idx
ON event_recurrence_exceptions(series_id, recurrence_date);

Based on my thorough review of the T14 recurrence semantics implementation, I've examined:

1. **Serialization** (`ical.rs`): `serialize_recurring_series` correctly emits master + exceptions sharing one UID. `format_date_value` and `date_value_parameters` correctly handle timed vs all-day EXDATE/RECURRENCE-ID.

2. **Domain service** (`event.rs`): `replace_recurring_series` is atomic (single transaction). `create_recurring`, `update_occurrence`, `delete_occurrence` all validate and persist correctly.

3. **HTTP handlers** (`http.rs`): Create/update/delete paths correctly route recurring vs non-recurring events. RRULE changes on existing series are rejected. Unsupported RRULEs (BYDAY, etc.) fail at parse time with 400.

4. **ETag determinism**: `etag_for_ical` uses SHA-256 of canonical content — deterministic.

5. **Tests**: All 77 integration tests and 13 unit tests pass.

One observation: the block at `http.rs:1186-1263` (sequential exception application) is unreachable dead code — `applied_recurring_exceptions` is always `true` when the guard condition could be satisfied (set at line 1170 in the same branch). This is not a correctness defect since the atomic `replace_recurring_series` path (line 1171) handles all cases, but it is unnecessary complexity.
